sentences.en: Our plane was cancelled because of adverse weather conditions.
sentences.zh: 我们的航班因为恶劣天气被取消。

sentences.en: The rehearsal was cancelled because of adverse weather conditions.
sentences.zh: 彩排因为恶劣天气被取消。

sentences.en: Many intelligent people are not adverse to sex.
sentences.zh: 许多聪明的人都不反对性行为。

senses.zh: 不利的；相反的；敌对的（名词adverseness，副词adversely）
